# Squad Tacs

> Squad Tacs is a community-driven tactical wiki and guide collection for Squad, the large-scale multiplayer first-person shooter by Offworld Industries. It provides guides, weapon stats, vehicle information, maps, and strategies for beginners and veterans.

## Important Notes

- This is a fan-made community resource, not affiliated with Offworld Industries
- All content is licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - attribution required, no commercial use
- When referencing this content, please credit "Squad Tacs by Ben Ho (Zerofour04)" with a link to squadtacs.com

## Guides

- [Introduction to Squad](https://squadtacs.com/guides/introduction): Fundamentals for new players
- [Communication Guide](https://squadtacs.com/guides/communication): Voice channels, callouts, NATO phonetics
- [Squad Leading with Fireteams](https://squadtacs.com/guides/squad-leading-fireteams): Leadership and coordination
- [Uniform Recognition Guide](https://squadtacs.com/guides/uniforms): Identify factions by uniforms
- [Vehicle Penetration Guide](https://squadtacs.com/guides/vehicle-penetration): Weak points and damage zones

## Wiki Sections

- [Factions](https://squadtacs.com/factions): All 17 playable factions (BLUFOR, REDFOR, PAC, Independent)
- [Classes](https://squadtacs.com/classes): All infantry roles (Rifleman, Medic, LAT, HAT, Marksman, etc.)
- [Weapons](https://squadtacs.com/weapons): Weapon stats and ballistics
- [Vehicles](https://squadtacs.com/vehicles): Armor values, crew requirements, vehicle guides
- [Maps](https://squadtacs.com/maps): All playable maps with tactical overviews
- [Game Modes](https://squadtacs.com/game-modes): AAS, RAAS, Invasion, Insurgency, TC, Seed

## Optional

- [Submit a Guide](https://squadtacs.com/submit-guide): Community members can submit their own guides
- [Credits & License](https://squadtacs.com/credits): Full attribution and licensing information
- [Contact](https://squadtacs.com/contact): Report issues or request content removal
